safety_review.findings: Fresh non-author reviewers, claude-sonnet-5-5 (three in parallel for the first read, then two confirm passes), read every weigh line in the ten step 1-4 banks on 2026-11-26 after the weigh-bridge rewrite (each step 1-4 คิดต่อ / Next thought line is now a question that turns the visitor, from the answer just chosen, toward what the next step asks), all three alternatives, Thai and English, against every question variant of its own bank and of the bank the option leads to. Strength, safety and every step 5 line are byte-identical to the bank reviewed on 2026-11-25 (checked by script). No line was found unsafe or to nudge toward harm. Must-fixes applied: "bedside", "where he is bleeding" and "while blood goes in" in step1 lines echoed or pointed at the FAST option or added a fact, now ask which first tests matter most while you resuscitate; "what must the lab prepare" described the crossmatch option; English "his loss" did not match Thai "blood"; "an hour after the crash" showed a fact only one variant has, and "still on the clock" echoed the TXA-within-3-hours lines; step2 "who do you call" then "if his condition gets worse" nudged toward waiting while he is already in shock, now "Whatever the first test shows, what will you do first for his shock?"; step4 "who and what must travel", "what decides how fast he leaves" and "receiving team" mapped onto the step 5 options, now ask what to settle before the ambulance leaves, how to send him, and what makes the journey safe. Should-fixes taken: "bleeding has truly stopped", "staying stable" on deteriorating paths, and "first response is not holding", which restated the next best line.
